name: The Black Anchor - Guild Board Alcove
description:
This reinforced alcove sits just beyond the noise of the common room. Thick planks and iron brackets muffle the din, leaving only a low hum of voices behind you.

A large notice board dominates the far wall, layered with contracts, bounties, and expedition postings. Some are freshly nailed; others curl at the edges, ignored or forgotten. Wax-sealed letters and stamped notices hint at interest from merchants, nobles, and powers far beyond New Cove.

A narrow desk nearby is stained with ink and wax, its ledgers opened and closed countless times.
ambient_lines: The guild clerk shuffles papers at the desk, muttering under his breath.
A notice comes loose from the board and flutters to the floor.
Someone's footsteps recede toward the common room.
Wax cracks as a sealed letter is pressed into the board.
enter_flavor: The guild clerk looks up from the ledgers as you approach the board.
The guild clerk mutters as you approach the board.
